description: Header file defining the FrontPanelImplementation class, which implements the IFrontPanel interface for managing front panel lights, LEDs, and power management notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: FrontPanelImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IFrontPanel interface, manages front panel lights, LEDs, and power mode notifications, and handles JSONRPC communication within the plugin.

classes.name: PowerManagerNotification
classes.description: Nested class that implements the IModeChangedNotification interface to handle power mode change events and notify the parent FrontPanelImplementation.

methods.name: SetBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of a specified front panel light or LED.

methods.name: GetBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level of a specified front panel light or LED.

methods.name: PowerLedOn
methods.description: Turns on the power LED indicator.

methods.name: PowerLedOff
methods.description: Turns off the power LED indicator.

methods.name: GetFrontPanelLights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported front panel lights and their information.

methods.name: SetLED
methods.description: Configures a specific LED indicator with brightness, color, and RGB values.

methods.name: SetBlink
methods.description: Sets blinking pattern for front panel LEDs.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes configuration with the plugin shell service.

methods.name: registerEventHandlers
methods.description: Registers event handlers for power management and front panel events.
